name: Google Search Console
summary: Your Search Console properties: search performance (clicks, impressions, CTR, position by query, page, country, device and date) and sitemaps.

client_id.description: the OAuth client id of a Google Cloud OAuth app with the Search Console API enabled (Google Cloud console > APIs & Services > Credentials)

refresh_token.description: a refresh token minted with that OAuth app for the scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly (reads) or https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters (to submit sitemaps)

notes: Own-account API: only properties the signed-in Google user has in Search Console.
The siteUrl path segment must be percent-encoded ('sc-domain%3Aexample.com', 'https%3A%2F%2Fwww.example.com%2F').
Dates are Pacific Time. Results come back sorted by clicks, or by date when grouped by date; the API returns top rows, not every row.
Search analytics pages with startRow; at most 25,000 rows per call.

endpoints.name: List Search Console properties
endpoints.summary: Every property the user has and their permission level.

endpoints.name: Query search performance
endpoints.summary: Clicks, impressions, CTR and average position grouped by dimensions over a date range.

siteUrl.description: The property exactly as Search Console shows it: 'https://www.example.com/' (trailing slash) or 'sc-domain:example.com'. URL-encode it in the path.

dimensions.description: Group by, in order: country, device, page, query, searchAppearance, date, hour. Omit for one total row.

type.description: web (default), image, video, news, discover or googleNews.

dimensionFilterGroups.description: [{groupType: 'and', filters: [{dimension, operator, expression}]}]. Operators: contains, equals, notContains, notEquals, includingRegex, excludingRegex.

dataState.description: final (default), all (includes fresh partial data) or hourly_all (use with the hour dimension).

notes: A read over POST. country values are ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes; device is DESKTOP, MOBILE or TABLET.
Fresh days can be partial: dataState 'all' includes them.

endpoints.name: List a property's sitemaps
endpoints.summary: Sitemaps submitted for a property with their status and errors.

siteUrl.description: The property exactly as Search Console shows it: 'https://www.example.com/' (trailing slash) or 'sc-domain:example.com'. URL-encode it in the path.

sitemapIndex.description: URL of a sitemap index to list the sitemaps inside it.
